relationshipTypes.name: வீடு கொடுத்தவர் தொடர்பு (House Lord / Dispositor)
relationshipTypes.description: The lord of the sign where a planet resides.

relationshipTypes.name: நட்சத்திர சார தொடர்பு (Star Lord Connection)
relationshipTypes.description: The ruler of the Nakshatra occupied by a planet.

relationshipTypes.name: பார்வை தொடர்பு (Planetary Aspect)
relationshipTypes.description: Standard 7th aspect for all planets; special 4th & 8th for Mars, 5th & 9th for Jupiter, 3rd & 10th for Saturn.

relationshipTypes.name: சேர்க்கை (Conjunction)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets occupying the same sign or close degree arc.

relationshipTypes.name: திரிகோண தொடர்பு (1-5-9 Trine)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets placed in 1st, 5th, or 9th from each other; activates Uyir Karakatvam.

relationshipTypes.name: கேந்திர தொடர்பு (1-4-7-10 Angular)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets placed in 1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th from each other; activates Porul Karakatvam.

relationshipTypes.name: 3-11 தொடர்பு (Effort & Gain)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets in 3rd/11th relationship requiring severe hard work before achievement.

relationshipTypes.name: 6-8 தொடர்பு (Dusthana Axis)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets in 6th/8th mutual relationship causing challenges, medical events, or sudden windfalls if exalted.

relationshipTypes.name: பரிவர்த்தனை (Mutual Exchange)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets exchanging each other's signs or star constellations; indicates change of direction / disappointment.

relationshipTypes.name: ராகு-கேது மையப்புள்ளி (Midpoint Axis)
relationshipTypes.description: Planets falling on the 4th house perpendicular axis from Rahu-Ketu.
